page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.32xlarge is an x86_64 general purpose instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T95 processor running at 2.25 GHz, providing 128 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration pairs these execution cores with 512.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM allocated per core.

The network architecture provides a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput communications. The server includes no local disk storage, requiring external network-attached block storage for the operating system and application storage layers. Hardware accelerators are not present, with zero GPUs bundled, and the configuration does not provision complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dense 128-core footprint provides high concurrency for horizontally scaled applications without the resource-skew of compute-focused or memory-heavy classes. Because persistent storage relies completely on remote block storage, I/O performance depends on network-attached disk choices. The platform is suited for multi-tenant container orchestration, large-scale microservices, enterprise backend systems, batch processing, and high-concurrency web serving.
